electrical_conclusion.basis: Every exported public untraced port maps one-to-one to an intentional native unconnected-* net; all three absent public native nodes are documented J_USB source-only internal ports within one explicit four-port internal record. No untraced source port maps to a connected native net and none lacks both native and internal evidence.
electrical_conclusion.limits: This proves source/native unconnected-port representation parity only; it does not qualify ERC warnings, board layout, routing, physical USB shell behavior, or system electrical behavior.

offset_resolution.equation: 149 source untraced ports = 146 ports with native unconnected-* nodes + 3 source-only internal J_USB ports
offset_resolution.explanation: The seven internal-connection records contain 29 source ports in total, but 26 of those ports already have source traces and native connected-node representations. Only three untraced source ports are source-only J_USB internals with no public pin number. Therefore subtracting all 29 would wrongly remove 26 traced ports; the actual untraced-port relationship is 149 = 146 + 3.
